name: repo-platform
description: Tooling manifest for repo-platform (biome, the bun scripts' yaml parser and zod schemas); the actions carry their own dependencies, which the root postinstall installs so one root bun install covers every action package.

scripts.check: bun run check:static && bun run docs:check && bun run test
scripts.check:static: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run typography && bun run file-size && bun run invariants
scripts.postinstall: for pkg in actions/*/package.json; do bun install --frozen-lockfile --silent --cwd "${pkg%/package.json}" || exit 1; done
